test_autotune_with_opentuner_ga: test the Autotuner with opentuner_ga algorithm on an LLVM environment using the cbench crc32 benchmark
run_autotuner_on_llvm_env: run an Autotuner instance on a CompilerGym LLVM environment to optimize code size with a time limit
create_compiler_gym_llvm_env: create a CompilerGym LLVM environment with IrInstructionCount reward space and reset it to a benchmark
review_autotuner_result: review the Autotuner result object including benchmark name, walltime, and generated command line
test_autotuner_integration: test the full autotuning integration by asserting result properties like walltime and episode reward
